target: m4_verify (C4 dose-range, C5 frequency/duration, config allowed units and blank-range policy, E4 drug swap) and docs/severity.md

findings.item: m4_verify/checks.py c4_dose_range (adult range applied to all patients)
findings.problem: A child given paracetamol 1000 mg three times a day passes C4 (in range, 3000 mg not above max). There is no age or child awareness.
findings.suggested_fix: When the transcript or encounter indicates a child (e.g. 'ಮಗು/ಮಗುವಿಗೆ') or the age is below 12, flag 'paediatric dose: weight-based, adult range not applicable'; add age/weight to record.v2.
findings.evidence: NHS: children's paracetamol depends on age and sometimes weight; 500 mg tablets only from age 10.

findings.item: m4_verify/config/default.yaml blank_range_fails_closed: true; C4 non-mass units branch
findings.problem: Safe as a default, but correct gold doses for 12 blank-range drugs and ALL tablet/capsule/sachet/ml doses are flagged, so flag and false-positive rates measure lexicon gaps.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep fail-closed but use a distinct reason code (unverifiable_no_range) reported separately from out_of_range; convert single-strength tablet counts to mg or allow 1-2 units per dose.
findings.evidence: checks.py lines 347-388: range_mg None -> flag; du not in MASS -> flag 'no verified range for unit'.

findings.item: C4 max-daily check and the missing regimen/duration plausibility
findings.problem: max_daily_mg is blank for 25 of 34 drugs, so e.g. levofloxacin 750 mg x 4/day or azithromycin 2000 mg/day for 5 days pass; duration is never checked.
findings.suggested_fix: Add max_daily_mg from labels (ciprofloxacin 1500 mg/day = 750 mg q12h; the others UNVERIFIED) and per-drug allowed frequencies.
findings.evidence: Ciprofloxacin label dosing table: 500-750 mg every 12 hours for skin infections.

findings.problem: Every unit is allowed for every drug: 'ceftriaxone 1 tablet' and 'ORS 500 mg' pass the unit test; no route check.
findings.suggested_fix: allowed_units_by_drug: ceftriaxone/cefazolin [mg, g]; ors [sachet, ml]; zinc [mg, tablet]; iron-folic acid [tablet, mg, mcg].
findings.evidence: config.py DEFAULT_ALLOWED_UNITS; lexicon_source.py form=injection for ceftriaxone/cefazolin.

findings.problem: Record-level swaps can pick non-lexicon confusables (prednisone, fomepizole, sertraline, sulfasalazine, folinic acid), which are caught trivially; drugs with no confusable fall back to random drugs (unrealistic).
findings.suggested_fix: Report non-lexicon and fallback swaps as separate rows or require need_in_lexicon=True; add within-lexicon pairs dexamethasone<->prednisolone, diclofenac<->ibuprofen (UNVERIFIED).
findings.evidence: planted.py _swap_drug(need_in_lexicon=False) at record level; FALLBACK note string.

findings.problem: Missing clinically critical classes: route, patient population / paediatric weight-based dose, liquid concentration/strength, adherence (stopped early vs never), as-needed instructions.
findings.suggested_fix: Add CR-ROUTE, CR-POPULATION, CR-STRENGTH, MA-ADHERENCE, MA-PRN via a decision entry; record.v2 fields for route/form/age/prn/adherence.
findings.evidence: NHS: 120 mg/5 ml vs 250 mg/5 ml paracetamol liquids, so an equal ml volume can deliver double the mg. record.v1 has no route/form/age fields.

findings.problem: '1-0-1', 'q8h'/'every 8 hours', 'HS', 'SOS'/PRN do not parse (safe flags but false alarms); 'per' is span-wide, so mixed spans can be mislabelled.
findings.suggested_fix: Add these patterns with tests; compute per-day/per-week locally around each number.
findings.evidence: FREQ_WORDS, PER_DAY and parse_frequencies in m4_verify/lexicon.py.

findings.problem: Type g is then partly detectable by plausibility rather than by the span; this must be stated.
findings.suggested_fix: Report it in the E4 results.

summary: SIMULATED clinical review (not clinical validation). Critical: C4 applies adult ranges to children (paracetamol 1000 mg tid for a child passes). Blank-range fail-closed is right for safety but must be a separate 'unverifiable' code, or verifier precision measures lexicon gaps. Major: 25/34 drugs lack max_daily; global allowed units (no route check); E4 swaps to non-lexicon or random drugs; taxonomy lacks route, population, strength, adherence and PRN.
